title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.3 (Peaked October 23, 2026 at 19:07 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C3.3 (Peaked October 23, 2026 at 05:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 426 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Active (Kp 4.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

The sky looks blue because molecules are scattered in Earth’s atmosphere — and blue light scatters especially strongly. 🌎💛

Image: NASA SDO — AIA 171 Å + HMI Magnetic Polarity
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
